text:
Rae: quick poll  for first-run samples do we use a top shelf, a dismissible toast, or both (shelf on first-run, toast on return)? Leaning shelf.
Jun: Shelf wins for discoverability. Toast is easy to miss and gets cluttered with other notifications.
Marco: Shelf affects header real estate. We can make it compressible: full on first-run, collapsed chip rail afterwards. Dev estimate ~2 days.
Tess: Accessibility: must add a skip-link target, announce once via aria-live, ensure cards have focus states, and meet AA contrast for overlay text. Also ensure the collapse chevron is keyboard operable.
Rae: Good. Copy idea for shelf header: "Try a starter project" + sub "Run one in under 5 minutes". Thoughts?
Jun: I like action-oriented copy. Suggest CTA "Run sample" vs "Open".
Marco: Technical note  use query params for stateless linking: /projects/:id?starter=vector-chat. Simpler than onboarding store.
Tess: A11y checklist I'll add to PR: 1) aria-live only first render, 2) focus order, 3) visible focus ring, 4) return focus after modal/sample closes.
Rae: Analytics: shelf_shown, shelf_collapsed, sample_started, sample_completed. Jun will own events.
Jun: I'll add a small funnel and a pulse retention check for week 1.
access-bot: Reminder: attach Figma handoff + tokens before EOD Thursday.
Marco: MVP plan: compact shelf (chips) + route param + analytics. Thumbnail-rich view as follow-up A/B. Estimate ship in next sprint if we cut animation polish.
Rae: Decision noted  go with compact shelf first-run, collapsed chip rail for return users, route param linking, instrument events, a11y checklist in PR. Marco start branch, Jun add analytics, Tess add checklist.
Tess: I'll run keyboard and screen reader pass once PR is up. :thumbsup:
Jun: pinging this thread when events are in.
Marco: branching now  will ping when PR is ready.
Rae: thanks team  moving to sprint board. :rocket:
